text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, isn't that Mayano? Meeting up with 
someone in a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ah! Fuji-senpai! Listen, listen!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see, so Akebono had urgent business and 
the movie was called off... So, are you 
going by yourself now?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No... Maya wanted to watch it together 
with Buono-chan. Besides, the time on the 
ticket has already passed...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please don't look so down. If you 
don't mind, Mayano, would you entrust the 
rest of today to me?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Fuji-senpai, are you gonna play with 
Maya?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Allow me to escort you to the most 
wonderful day imaginable!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Well then, well then! Maya today—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, that looks so mature! 
Fuji-senpai, look, those gloves! So cool, 
I want some too~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's certainly a lovely design, but... 
right now, I'd rather you leave the job of 
keeping your hands warm to me.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Wha?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Is it uncool of me to be jealous of 
everything that touches you? ...Hehe, just 
kidding."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
(Whoa, whoa, whoaaa! Is this what a 
"sweet, mature date" is like?! Fuji-senpai 
is amazing!)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The scenery resembling the underwater 
world was lovely, but it pales in 
comparison to watching your profile as you 
gaze at the fish.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Am I not worthy enough as your 
opponent? I must take care not to be 
captivated by those serious eyes of yours.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
From now on, whenever I gaze upon the 
sunset, I shall surely be reminded of you. 
As if gently touching your hair—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Kyah~!? No way, this is impossible! Maya 
can't even breathe! It's way too mature, 
no fair, no way!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you done already? Fufu, in that 
case, how about I entertain you as just 
plain old me from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Maya-chan~! Sorry for being late~! 
Fuji-san, thanks for the tickets~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Wait, what!? Bono-chan!? Why are 
you here? What about your urgent 
business!? And tickets... Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
When I contacted them, they said they'd 
just wrapped up some urgent business. So I 
went ahead and reserved our movie tickets 
for this time slot earlier.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Since when!? No way, no way, Maya 
didn't even notice! How did you do that~!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, there are no tricks or gimmicks 
here! As long as I can see the smiles of 
my lovely ponies, I'll make any miracle 
happen♪
